original_text:
–Biologist–an expert in or student of the branch of science concerning living organisms.
–Scientist–a person who is studying or has expert knowledge of one or more of the natural or physical sciences.
–The difference between a biologist and a biological scientist is research.
explanation: This slide defines the terms 'Biologist' and 'Scientist' and distinguishes between them. A biologist is defined as an expert in or student of the branch of science concerning living organisms. A scientist is defined as a person who is studying or has expert knowledge of one or more of the natural or physical sciences. Crucially, the slide states that the primary difference between a biologist and a biological scientist is research.
